behavior: A part that keeps nodes beside its element has one root node: a trigger with focus guards, `NavigationMenu.Viewport` in a positioner with its focus guards, and `Toast.Viewport` with its focus guard and its alert region. A rule of `<style scoped>`, `v-show`, a custom directive and `<Transition>` of the consumer thus apply to the element of the part, also while the nodes are in the document.
